scope: Matched short-prefill control after identical direct/code/topic/counting and three mixed sweeps; not a rerun of the complete release matrix.
findings: V3 also slows after accumulated decode history: retained +1K/+2K are 5.7%/6.7% below its fresh controls.
Under matched decode history, v4 is 5.4%/5.8% faster than v3 at retained +1K/+2K; retained +8K is 1.4% lower.

The 10–17% historical full-matrix short-prefill loss does not reproduce in the fresh or matched-decode-history controls. The full matrix also includes long-context decode history, which this focused control does not reproduce; these results do not isolate the exact internal source of state sensitivity.
Keep original final-matrix values and historical comparisons visible; do not substitute these focused measurements into headline tables.
